saints.name: St. Zephyrinus
saints.title: Pope
saints.shortBlurb: A pope of the early third century who guided the Roman Church through fierce doctrinal storms…
biography: Zephyrinus, a Roman by birth, was Bishop of Rome from about 199 to 217, during years troubled by both persecution and doctrinal conflict. He relied heavily on the deacon Callixtus, whom he set over the Christian cemeteries and who would succeed him as pope.

His reign was marked by the struggle against the Monarchian errors that denied the distinction of Persons in God, and he defended the Church's faith amid the disputes of learned rivals. Long honored as a confessor of the faith, he was buried in his own cemetery on the Appian Way.
saints.knownFor: Guiding the Roman Church amid early Trinitarian controversies.
